topic: Vehicle Mode and Usage Mode Definitions for Z-ONE-3.0 Platform
row_semantics: Each row represents a distinct mode or state variable related to vehicle operation and usage.
column_semantics: Columns define the communication interface (CAN, ZXD, LHZCU) and system status (VS SSTS) for each mode variable.

core_entities.name: VehMd
core_entities.description: Vehicle Mode, indicating the operational state of the vehicle.

core_entities.name: VehMdV
core_entities.description: Vehicle Mode Validity, indicating whether the VehMd value is valid.

core_entities.name: UsGmD
core_entities.description: Usage Mode, indicating the intended use case of the vehicle.

core_entities.name: UsGmDV
core_entities.description: Usage Mode Validity, indicating whether the UsGmD value is valid.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the valid states and their corresponding hexadecimal values for Vehicle Mode (VehMd) and Usage Mode (UsGmD), along with their validity indicators (VehMdV, UsGmDV). It is used for testing the correct interpretation and transmission of these modes across different communication interfaces (CAN, ZXD, LHZCU) within the Z-ONE-3.0 platform.
